node.title: Re^3: read files one by one in directory and redirct output to a file
node.author: Marshall
node.doctext:
On Windows, I believe the equivalent to your Unix command would be: type *.log > result On Unix, I think copy is cp. On either O/S it is possible to concatenate a bunch of binary files together into a single result file.
copy (cp) works with binary files. type or cat is designed to work with text files.
